name: Thorn Jab
description: Drive a fist wrapped in a thorn of green qi into the opponent's chest or shoulder.

name: Barkstand
description: Harden the forearm with a layer of bark-like qi and meet the incoming blow with it.

name: Vine Pull
description: Throw a thin line of green qi around the opponent's wrist and haul the arm off its line.

name: Sapmend
description: Press green qi into the user's own shallow cut or bruise until the flesh closes and the sting fades.

name: Leaf Step
description: Shift the weight to the toes and glide one short pace aside as lightly as a falling leaf.

name: Footroot
description: Send qi down through the soles so the user's own stance grips the ground and cannot be shoved loose.

name: Sprout Strike
description: Spring up from a crouch and drive the heel of the palm under the opponent's chin.

name: Seed Shot
description: Flick a hard seed charged with qi from the thumb at the opponent's face.

name: Green Palm
description: Push an open palm filled with growing qi into the opponent's ribs so the force spreads through them.

name: Sapling Sway
description: Bend the body away from a strike like a young tree in wind and spring back after it passes.

name: Dew Sip
description: Draw the damp from the air through the skin to refill the user's breath and steady a tired arm.

name: Barb Flick
description: Snap the back of the hand across the opponent's cheek with a barb of qi standing from the knuckle.

name: Thorn Fling
description: Throw a handful of small qi thorns that sting the opponent's hands and face.

name: Vine Snare
description: Cast a loop of green qi at the opponent's ankles so the next step catches and holds.

name: Briar Hook
description: Hook a thorned line of qi behind the opponent's heel and jerk it to spoil the step.

name: Creeper Wrap
description: Wind a living cord of qi around the opponent's forearm and tighten it each breath.

name: Prickle Screen
description: Raise a loose net of fine qi thorns before the body that stings whatever strikes into it.

name: Bark Plate
description: Grow a broad plate of bark qi over the chest and take the blow on it.

name: Bark Skin
description: Spread a thin rough layer of qi over the whole skin and hold it through a short exchange.

name: Whorl Guard
description: Turn a knotted forearm across the line of a cut and let the blow slide off the hard whorl.

name: Rough Rind
description: Roughen the shoulder with a crust of qi to catch and scrape a grappling hand.

name: Barkburst
description: Shatter the bark layer outward from the forearm so the flying shards hit the opponent at close range.

name: Woodfist
description: Harden the fist like dry timber and punch straight through the opponent's guard.

name: Splinter Check
description: Meet a grab with a rough forearm that sheds sharp splinters of qi and slips the hold.

name: Sapknit
description: Draw life sap along the meridians to the user's own wound so torn muscle knits and bleeding slows.

name: Green Salve
description: Rub a smear of green qi into a wounded ally's skin to close cuts and ease soreness.

name: Leafbind
description: Lay a qi-charged leaf over an ally's wound and bind it in place so the bleeding stops.

name: Dewfall
description: Let a cool mist of qi settle on the user's own bruised arm and draw down the swelling.

name: Budhold
description: Rest a hand on an ally's chest and lend steady green qi until the ally's breath evens.

name: Rootlisten
description: Spread qi roots through the ground to feel the weight and pace of anyone walking nearby.

name: Rootgrip
description: Sink qi roots from the feet into the ground to add grip and push to the user's own stance.

name: Taproot Drop
description: Drop a single deep root of qi through the legs so a shove or a sweep cannot move the user.

name: Rootsnag
description: Raise a knuckle of root from the ground to catch the opponent's lead foot.

name: Root Heave
description: Drive upward from rooted legs and shoulder the opponent off the ground in one push.

name: Rootshift
description: Pull the rooted foot free and slide it a pace to the side without losing the stance.

name: Stem Lash
description: Whip a flexible stem of qi from the palm across the opponent's arm or knee.

name: Creep Step
description: Slide low and close along the ground on hands and feet to come inside the opponent's reach.

name: Stemwrap
description: Loop a stem of green qi around the opponent's calf and pull the leg out from under them.

name: Tightening Coil
description: Close a coil of qi around the opponent's torso and draw it tighter with every breath.

name: Low Reach
description: Send a creeping line of qi along the ground to jam under the opponent's rising foot.

name: Tendril Tug
description: Flick a fine tendril at a held weapon and tug it sharply out of line.

name: Mat Creeper
description: Spread a mat of living qi under the opponent's feet that tangles each step they try to take.

name: Barb Snag
description: Stretch a barbed thread of qi across the guard to catch and slow an incoming limb.

name: Leaf Drift
description: Let the body float sideways on a breath of qi like a leaf turned by a draught.

name: Petal Screen
description: Spread a fan of soft petal-shaped qi sheets before the face to blunt a thrust.

name: Falling Leaf
description: Drop the shoulder and spiral away from a blow so its force follows the user's turning weight past.

name: Petal Flick
description: Fling a spray of razor-edged petals of qi that nick the opponent's hands and eyes.

name: Leaf Read
description: Hold a leaf in the palm and feel the stir of nearby qi and movement through its veins.

name: Twig Snap
description: Snap two fingers wrapped in hard qi against the opponent's wrist or throat.

name: Briar Whip
description: Lash a thorned whip of qi across the opponent's guard to scratch and sting.

name: Snagbriar
description: Hold a bramble of qi in the path of the blade so the edge catches and drags aside.

name: Twig Prod
description: Stab a hardened finger-length twig of qi into a joint or gap in the opponent's guard.

name: Briar Guard
description: Cross the arms behind a tangle of qi briars that scratches any hand that reaches in.

name: Twig Splint
description: Bind a broken finger or forearm in a rigid twig of qi that holds the bone while it mends.

name: Moss Cushion
description: Layer thick soft qi over the guard arm to soak a heavy blow like a bed of moss.

name: Moss Step
description: Tread with a soft qi pad on the sole so the foot lands without sound and without slipping.

name: Fern Curl
description: Unroll a curled frond of qi that wraps the opponent's wrist and turns the hand away.

name: Fern Unfurl
description: Whip a frond of hard qi outward from a closed fist across the opponent's face.

name: Mossmend
description: Pack soft damp qi into an ally's scrape or burn so it cools and the skin knits over.

name: Calm Moss
description: Settle slow green qi over an ally's mind so a racing heart quiets and the hands steady.
